fact: 1907年10月1日，齐柏林伯爵的第三艘硬式飞艇LZ-3完成8小时、航程超过218.5英里（350公里）的示范飞行；德国政府官员随即表示，若飞艇满足包括24小时连续飞行在内的条件，愿意接管齐柏林的飞艇。国家买家在此进入。

sources.title: Harry Vissering, Zeppelin: The Story of a Great Achievement (with information furnished by Luftschiffbau-Zeppelin), Project Gutenberg eBook #32570
sources.quote: Meanwhile he continued his demonstration flights with his third ship, culminating on October 1st, 1907, in a brilliant 8 hour flight of more than 218.5 miles (350 kilometers). Thereupon the Government officials declared their willingness to take over Count Zeppelin's ships if they fulfilled certain requirements, among them a twenty-four hour flight.

fact: 齐柏林项目1898年即以股份公司形式募资：Aktiengesellschaft zur Förderung der Motorluftschiffahrt（促进电动飞艇航运股份公司）实收资本100万马克（约23.8万美元）。到1907年示范飞行成功时，飞艇企业已是德意志帝国境内以私人股本+公共示范驱动的技术公司形态。

sources.title: Harry Vissering, Zeppelin: The Story of a Great Achievement (with information furnished by Luftschiffbau-Zeppelin), Project Gutenberg eBook #32570
sources.quote: Zeppelin, in spite of many difficulties, succeeded in enlisting the necessary private capital and in 1898 organized a stock company (Aktiengesellschaft zur Foerderung der Motorluftschiffahrt) to promote motor airship flights. It had a paid in capital of one million marks ($238,000).

fact: 齐柏林的资本结构在1908年因公众募捐而重塑：LZ-4在埃希特林根（Echterdingen）坠毁后，各地发起的大众募捐在数周内募集600万马克（约150万美元），“来自贵贱各方”的资金直接交给齐柏林；他随即以这笔钱成立“齐柏林飞艇促进基金会”（Zeppelinstiftung zur Förderung der Luftfahrt），该基金会成为Luftschiffbau Zeppelin（建造公司）的独家股东。

sources.title: Harry Vissering, Zeppelin: The Story of a Great Achievement (with information furnished by Luftschiffbau-Zeppelin), Project Gutenberg eBook #32570
sources.quote: When it was learned that Count Zeppelin had no funds with which to continue, a popular subscription campaign was started in various sections, with the result that within a few weeks 6,000,000 marks (approximately $1,500,000) had been contributed and turned over to Zeppelin for him to use as he saw fit in carrying on his experiments. ... With the 6,000,000 marks presented to him Count Zeppelin founded the "Zeppelinstiftung zur Foerderung der Luftfahrt" (Zeppelin Endowment for the Propagation of Air Navigation). This organization is the exclusive shareholder of Luftschiffbau Zeppelin (the constructing company)

fact: 德国电力化在1907年前已达到高覆盖：19世纪90年代后半期全国发电厂数量翻两番以上至774座；至1907年，三分之二的大中城市已拥有电力厂。电力设备需求的广度为AEG、西门子等公司提供了持续订单基础。

sources.title: Siemens, 175 Years of Siemens (official company history PDF, English edition)
sources.quote: One consequence of growing electricity consumption was that in the second half of the 1890s, the number of electricity plants in Germany more than quadrupled to 774. By 1907, two-thirds of all large and medium-size cities had an electric power plant.

fact: AEG（Allgemeine Elektricitäts-Gesellschaft，前身Emil Rathenau 1883年创办的Deutsche Edison-Gesellschaft，1887年更名）至1898年已成为德国营业额最高的电气设备公司；银行资本——尤其是德意志银行——为AEG进入“设备销售+供电”一体化的高投入“风险事业”提供了腾挪空间。西门子与AEG的竞争贯穿数十年，但双方于1903年合资成立Telefunken无线电商社，显示电气托拉斯之间的合作型卡特尔同样活跃。

sources.title: Siemens, 175 Years of Siemens (official company history PDF, English edition)
sources.quote: By 1898, AEG had become Germany’s highest-revenue electrical equipment company. ... capital investments by banks ‒ especially Deutsche Bank ‒ gave AEG the leeway to get into the expensive “venture” business, which combined selling both electrical equipment and electric power. ... One of the most important of the joint ventures founded by AEG and Siemens came in 1903, with the “Gesellschaft für drahtlose Telegraphie mbH – System Telefunken” (the Company for Wireless Telegraphy, Limited – Telefunken System).

fact: 德国化学工业的结构特征在1907年前后已经定型：以Hoechst为例，19世纪末至20世纪初染料长期约占其销售额的90%；德国染料工业依托大学研究体系，技术专长“世界无出其右”。拜耳（Friedrich Bayer染料工厂，1863年创立）1899年注册阿司匹林商标；三大化学公司直到1925年才合并为I.G. Farben。

sources.title: Funding Universe — Hoechst A.G. History
sources.quote: Throughout the late 19th and early 20th centuries, dyestuffs accounted for 90 percent of Hoechst's sales. ... the German dye industry, with its ties to major universities, had a degree of technical expertise unrivaled in the world.

fact: 齐柏林航线化的结果：1910年6月Deutschland号成为世界首艘商用飞艇；1910年至一战爆发的1914年间，德国齐柏林飞艇累计飞行107,208英里（172,535公里），安全运送乘客与机组34,028人次；一战爆发时德国拥有10艘齐柏林飞艇。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Zeppelin (Lighter-than-Air essay)
sources.quote: In June 1910, the Deutschland became the world’s first commercial airship. ... Between 1910 and the beginning of World War I in 1914, German zeppelins flew 107,208 (172,535 kilometers) miles and carried 34,028 passengers and crew safely. At the beginning of World War I, Germany had ten zeppelins.

fact: 1908年秋，德国议会（Reichstag）与联邦参议院（Bundesrath）成员约百人亲赴腓特烈港乘坐齐柏林飞艇，飞艇成为国家技术象征与政治景观；同年大众募捐成立的基金会体制把飞艇企业锚定在“国民企业”定位上。

sources.title: Harry Vissering, Zeppelin: The Story of a Great Achievement (with information furnished by Luftschiffbau-Zeppelin), Project Gutenberg eBook #32570
sources.quote: In the fall of 1908 the members of the Reichstag and the Bundesrath came to Friedrichshafen, a hundred or more trusting themselves to the Zeppelin ship, the sole feature of the national celebration.
